Setbacks do not erase previous learning. This is an everyday maintenance plan, not a crisis or treatment plan. If you need urgent help, use local emergency or crisis support.

::: {#maintaining-progress-app .skill-app data-practice-app="maintaining-progress"}
Loading Maintaining Progress Plan...
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="A worked example"}
Jordan notices that busy weeks lead to missed meals and cancelled plans. Their first response is one easy meal and a message to a trusted friend. They put a reminder in their calendar to review whether this is enough support.
:::
